```yaml
name: Nightly Commitizen & Changelog Check

on:
  schedule:
    # Run at 00:00 UTC every day
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow manual trigger for testing

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-commitizen-config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install commitizen pre-commit

      - name: Verify Commitizen Configuration
        run: |
          # Check if pyproject.toml exists and has commitizen config
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
            if grep -q "\[tool.commitizen\]" pyproject.toml; then
              echo "Commitizen configuration found in pyproject.toml"
              cz version
            else
              echo "::warning::No [tool.commitizen] section found in pyproject.toml"
            fi
          else
            echo "::warning::pyproject.toml not found"
          fi

      - name: Run Pre-commit Hooks (Commit Msg Check)
        uses: pre-commit/action@v3.0.1
        with:
          extra_args: --hook-stage manual --all-files
        continue-on-error: true # Nightly checks are informational

      - name: Validate Recent Commits Format
        run: |
          # Check the last 10 commits for conventional commit format
          # This is a basic check; full validation is done by pre-commit on push
          echo "Checking recent commits for conventional format..."
          git log --format="%s" -10 | while read -r commit_msg; do
            # Basic regex for conventional commits: type(scope): description
            if ! echo "$commit_msg" | grep -qE "^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert)(\(.+\))?: .+"; then
              echo "::warning::Commit '$commit_msg' does not appear to follow conventional commit format"
            fi
          done

      - name: Check Changelog Status
        run: |
          if [ -f CHANGELOG.md ]; then
            echo "CHANGELOG.md exists"
            # Check if the latest version in changelog matches the current package version
            CURRENT_VERSION=$(cz version 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
            LATEST_CHANGELOG_VERSION=$(grep -oP 'v?\K[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' CHANGELOG.md | head -n 1)
            
            if [ "$CURRENT_VERSION" != "unknown" ] && [ -n "$LATEST_CHANGELOG_VERSION" ]; then
              if [ "$CURRENT_VERSION" != "$LATEST_CHANGELOG_VERSION" ]; then
                echo "::warning::Current version ($CURRENT_VERSION) does not match latest changelog version ($LATEST_CHANGELOG_VERSION)"
              else
                echo "Version in CHANGELOG.md matches current package version"
              fi
            fi
          else
            echo "::warning::CHANGELOG.md not found"
          fi
```
